lists.deleteConfirm: "{name}" disappears from the dropdown. Records already using it keep their text.

history.title: Employment history
history.subtitle: Where this person worked, in which role and under whom — by the date each change took effect.
history.nowHint: Today or earlier: the change applies immediately.
history.futureHint: A future date: the change waits as "Scheduled" and takes effect automatically on that day.
history.keepCurrent: Fill only what changes; leave the rest empty to keep it as it is.
history.pickOne: Choose a new branch / department, job title or manager.
history.cancelConfirm: Cancel the change scheduled for {date}? It will not take effect.
history.pageSubtitle: Changes of branch, job title and manager in {company} — upcoming and past.
history.pageEmptyHint: Changes are entered from an employee's file → Career history → Transfer / promotion.

registers.contractsSubtitle: Every contract in {company} — status, term and platform reference. Salaries stay on the employee file.
registers.documentsSubtitle: Iqama, passports, permits and other dated documents in {company} — expired and due soon.
registers.offboardingsSubtitle: People leaving {company} and the step each case is at.

auditTrail.title: Audit trail
auditTrail.subtitle: Who did what in {company}, when and from where — with before and after values for edits. Entries can never be changed or deleted.

readiness.title: Ready for work & payroll
readiness.hint: Attendance and payroll accept this person only when every required item holds.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: Is everything running? Database, background work, e-mail delivery and storage — for administrators.

explain.redis: Carries the e-mail queue and the automation jobs.
explain.automation: The last reminder, expiry or dated change the engine wrote.
explain.failedEmails: Check the mail settings of the company if this grows.
explain.stuckEmails: The mail worker may be stopped.
explain.failedChanges: Transfers whose unit or title closed before their date — see Transfers & promotions.

health.noQueue: No queue — e-mails are sent directly (inline mode).

shifts.title: Shifts & patterns
shifts.subtitle: The working hours of {company}: reusable shifts, and the weekly or rotating patterns people are put on.
shifts.fixedHint: Starts and ends at set times.
shifts.flexibleHint: A window during which the required time must be worked.
shifts.noShiftsHint: Start with your usual working hours, e.g. 08:00–16:00.
shifts.weeklyHint: The same shifts each week — e.g. Sunday to Thursday mornings.
shifts.rotationHint: A cycle that repeats from each person's start date — e.g. 2 nights, 2 off.
shifts.noPatternsHint: Create shifts first, then a pattern that places them on days.

schedule.title: Work schedule
schedule.subtitle: The shifts of the next two weeks, day by day — holidays included.
schedule.removeConfirm: Remove this schedule? It has not started yet.
schedule.temporaryHint: Covers a limited period (a covering week, Ramadan hours…) and overrides the regular schedule on those days.
schedule.openEndedHint: Leave empty to keep it until further notice.
schedule.replacesHint: A new regular schedule ends the current one the day before it starts.
schedule.noPatterns: There is no active pattern yet — create one under Workforce → Shifts & patterns.
schedule.teamSubtitle: Who works what in {company}, week by week.
schedule.teamEmpty: Nobody to show for this filter.

attendance.daysHint: Each day is judged against the schedule a few hours after its shift ends.
attendance.recordHint: Enter the real times of the day. A clock-out earlier than the clock-in counts as the next morning.
attendance.noDays: No attendance days for this month yet.
attendance.deletePunchConfirm: Delete this punch? The day is recalculated without it.
attendance.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this overtime request? It has not been decided yet.
attendance.nextDayHint: Earlier than the clock-in = the next morning
attendance.overtimeHint: Overtime is paid only after approval by the branch manager, the company manager or a super admin (default rate: hourly wage + 50% of the basic hourly wage, Labour Law Art. 107).
attendance.registerSubtitle: Every judged day in {company}. Absences and lateness are only deducted after you confirm them.
attendance.registerEmpty: No attendance days for this filter.
attendance.confirmHint: Confirmed absences, lateness and early leave may be deducted by payroll.
attendance.overtimePageSubtitle: Overtime entered in {company}, with what each day recorded.
attendance.notJudgedYet: The day has not been judged yet.
attendance.approveOvertimeHint: You may approve fewer minutes than asked.

leave.balancesHint: Balances build up month by month; approved leave is taken off.
leave.cancelConfirm: Cancel this leave? It has not been decided yet.
leave.cancelApprovedConfirm: Cancel this approved leave? Its days go back to the balance and the attendance days are recalculated.
leave.adjustHint: Add days (e.g. the opening balance at go-live) or remove them with a minus sign. The reason is kept in the history.
leave.pageSubtitle: Leave entered in {company}, waiting for a decision first.
leave.approveHint: The days are taken off the balance and the attendance days are marked as leave.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.subtitle: The kinds of leave in {company} and their rules.
leaveTypes.defaultsNote: The built-in types follow the Saudi Labour Law (Arts. 109, 113, 114, 117, 151, 160) as defaults. Please confirm them with HR or legal before the first payroll — every number can be edited.
leaveTypes.deleteConfirm: Delete this leave type? It has never been used.
leaveTypes.tiersHint: Days already taken this year move the leave down the steps (sick leave: 30 days 100%, 60 days 75%, 30 days unpaid).
leaveTypes.sumMax: up to {n} days at a time

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Leave and overtime waiting for your decision in {company}, oldest first.
approvals.emptyDecided: You have not decided anything yet.

pay.confidential: Visible only to people allowed to see pay.
pay.none: No pay has been entered yet.
pay.removeConfirm: Remove this scheduled pay change? It has not taken effect yet.
pay.changeHint: A change applies from the date you choose; earlier months keep the pay they had. Leave a component empty if it does not apply.
pay.reasonHint: E.g. annual raise, promotion, new allowance — kept in the history.

paySetup.title: Payroll setup
paySetup.subtitle: Pay components and payroll rules of {company}.
paySetup.componentsHint: What can appear on a payslip. Amounts are entered on each employee's Pay tab.
paySetup.deleteComponentConfirm: Delete this pay component? Nobody is paid with it.
paySetup.defaultPercentHint: Pre-filled for new pay; each employee can differ.
paySetup.rulesHint: New rules apply from the date you choose (today or later). Months already paid keep the rules they were paid with.
paySetup.cutoffHint: Attendance up to this day counts in the month
paySetup.overtimePremiumValue: hourly wage + {n}% of the basic hourly wage (Art. 107)
paySetup.gosiHint: Enter the rates that apply to your company. Empty rates are not deducted — payroll will warn before running without them.
paySetup.gosiMissing: GOSI rates are not set yet — enter them under Payroll rules before the first payroll.
